subject: Greenwave Q4 expansion commit & pipeline hygiene
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>, Sam Park <sam.park@greenwave.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Greenwave Q4 expansion commit & pipeline hygiene

Hi team — looping you in to align on the expected Q4 expansion commit for Greenwave (pilot -> enterprise expansion). Finance wants a firmed-up commit by the end of next week so they can lock the forecast for December close. Quick asks: 

- Monica: can you confirm the CS health summary and the recommended commit amount (net new ARR) you expect to mark as "commit" in HubSpot? If you can attach the usage trend and any product blockers, that helps finance qualify the risk.
- Evelyn: what exact doc/form do you need to consider this for the monthly forecast? We usually need a signed SOW/PO or at least a committed expansion amount + expected start date.
- Avery: please review the stage (Negotiation -> Commitment) and flag any deals we should not commit this cycle.

I've attached a lightweight commit template (commit_template.xlsx) and a one-page snapshot (greenwave_q4_snapshot.pdf) I pulled from the pipeline. Planning a short commit review on Monday 11/30 at 10:00 PT — let me know if that works.

Thanks — I'll consolidate answers into the forecast sheet ahead of the meeting.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Greenwave Q4 expansion commit & pipeline hygiene

Thanks Rishi — quick update from CS side.

Summary:
- Health: Good — Greenwave's pilot hit the performance SLAs last week, and we see consistent token throughput growth (+18% w/w).
- Risks: Procurement timeline is the main gating item; procurement needs SOW + billing terms clarified. No technical blockers from engineering.
- Recommended commit: $180k ARR (50 seats, standard enterprise + 8% usage discount) to be marked as "commit" for Dec close, contingent on PO by 12/08.

Attachments: I exported a short usage report and a snapshot for your review (greenwave_q4_snapshot.pdf).

I can join the Monday 11/30 call and bring the CS win plan.

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Greenwave Q4 expansion commit & pipeline hygiene

Thanks — Evelyn here from Finance. To include the $180k in the formal December forecast we need one of the following by EOD 2026-12-08:

1) Signed SOW or PO referencing the expansion amount and billing cadence, or
2) A Sales-signed commitment email with clear scope and start date plus a HubSpot deal stage update to "Commit - Legal/PO pending" (we'll treat as committed with risk adjustment).

I've already added a provisional row to the forecast workbook and linked the HubSpot deal (see link). Please make sure ARR is shown as net ARR (post-discount). If procurement requires special billing terms, flag immediately — longer billing cycles can push recognition into Q1.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Revenue Finance, Redwood Inference
evelyn@redwood.com
From: Sam Park <sam.park@greenwave.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greenwave.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:47:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Greenwave Q4 expansion commit & pipeline hygiene

Hi Rishi & team — thanks for the context. Greenwave remains committed to the expansion; procurement asked me to confirm a couple of items:

- Billing start: we expect billing to begin when the SOW is executed and seats are provisioned (targeting 2027-01-04). Is that compatible?
- Discount: the 8% usage discount is acceptable, but procurement may push for an annual prepay option. Can you confirm if prepay pricing is materially different?

We should be able to get a PO to you by 12/08 if we have a draft SOW by 12/01. Sam (procurement) from our team is CC'd for visibility.

— Sam
Sam Park
Head of IT & Procurement, Greenwave Systems
sam.park@greenwave.com | +1 312-555-0444

Thanks everyone — quick recap/action items before the 11/30 commit review: 

- Monica: please update HubSpot deal stage to "Commit - Legal/PO pending" and confirm the $180k net ARR figure in the deal record by EOD 11/27. Also bring the usage report to the call.
- Evelyn: finance will treat this as a forecasted commit pending PO; please leave the provisional row but add a note about the 12/08 PO contingency.
- Avery: if you have objections to committing this deal, flag them now; otherwise we'll include it in the consolidated commit for Monday.
- Sam/Greenwave: Rishi will share a draft SOW by 12/01; procurement's PO by 12/08 will be sufficient to move to recognized commit in December.

Meeting: Monday 2026-11-30 10:00 PT — join link: https://meet.google.com/abc-xyz-123.

Attachments referenced: commit_template.xlsx, greenwave_q4_snapshot.pdf

I'll send a single-row summary to Finance after the call.
